approved.releaseGo: Option B: if every R1 gate passes (source/security/runtime gates, sealed immutable candidate, exact replay, frozen value test with unchanged denominators and its pass verdict), the hosted civic MCP release of the richer dataset may be deployed from the VM by the ops session through the existing governed dispatcher without waiting for a further owner GO; the owner audits the value-test samples afterwards. approved.buzzDemo: After the release, a Buzz agent asks/answers questions in Buzz that demonstrate what the data allows: comparing municipalities and how they can learn from each other. Implemented by the ops session through the governed Buzz change process.
approved.futureScope: Extension to neighbouring municipalities only later and only if this turns out well (separate decision).

notApproved: Skipping or weakening any gate, review or the frozen value test
